title: SSO end-user UX: every refusal says "the sign-in link expired", internal terms reach end users, a refused IdP-initiated sign-in is silent, and Log out leaves the IdP session so the next click signs straight back in
body:
## Edition / version
ObjectOS Enterprise, cloud `main` `de8d979` (framework pin `e24136c2`). Live Okta (OIDC and SAML), browser walk-through for objectstack-ai/cloud#3666.

## Findings, in the order a user meets them
1. **"Sign in with SSO" with an empty email** shows the raw `email, organizationSlug, domain or providerId is required`. It should say "Enter your work email to sign in with SSO" (the button reads the password form's email field).
2. **Every SSO refusal starts with the wrong sentence.** The login page shows "Single sign-on could not be completed — the sign-in link expired or was already used. Please try again." followed by the cause in parentheses, for:
   - `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` (uninvited user, JIT off): the cause text is right but aimed at admins: "(audience posture invite_only) … turn on just-in-time provisioning (allowJit)";
   - `account_not_linked`;
   - `saml_error / Invalid SAML response` (certificate mismatch);
   - `state_not_found`.
   None of these is an expired link, and "try again" only repeats the refusal. Expected: a per-cause sentence for the end user ("Your account isn't set up for this system yet. Ask your administrator to invite you." etc.), with the technical cause kept for admins (logs or a details toggle).
3. **A refused SAML IdP-initiated sign-in is silent.** With `allowIdpInitiated` off, the Okta tile lands on `/_console/login` with no message. The server logs "SAML IdP-initiated SSO rejected: InResponseTo missing and allowIdpInitiated is false". The page should say that sign-in has to start from this system's login page, or that the admin must allow IdP-initiated sign-in.
4. **Log out does not end the IdP session.** After Log out, "Sign in with SSO" signed the same user straight back in with no password prompt (Okta session alive). On a shared computer the next person gets the previous user's account. Expected: RP-initiated logout to the IdP's `end_session_endpoint` for OIDC (Okta and Entra both publish one) and SAML SLO where configured, or at least an admin setting for it.
5. **IdP-provisioned users:** the user record shows "Email Verified: No" although the IdP asserted the email, and offers "Set Password", which gives an SSO-only user a local password that bypasses the IdP. That may be intended; enterprise customers usually want SSO-provisioned users to sign in only through the IdP, or at least a warning on that button.
6. **Edit Sign-In Options** renders its two independent checkboxes (Allow IdP-Initiated, Allow JIT) as round, radio-style controls, which read as either/or.

What works well: the IdP-provisioned users are labelled "IdP-Provisioned" in the Users list; JIT, group → permission-set projection and OIDC signing-key rotation (Okta `keyRotate`) all worked live; the delete dialog explains the consequence for the domain's users.
